description.zh: 用于保证请求的幂等性。由客户端生成该参数值，要保证在不同请求间唯一，最大不超过64个ASCII字符。
description.en: A unique token generated by the client to ensure idempotence of the request. The value must be unique across different requests and can contain up to 64 ASCII characters.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun elasticsearch renew-logstash --instance-id ls-cn-n6w1o5jq0000 --client-token 5A2CFF0E-5718-45B5-9D4D-70B3FF0000 --biz-body example-string --api-version 2017-06-13 --region cn-hangzhou
